analyst_view.overall: A Baltic meeting in Kaunas between Kauno Zalgiris, last of 36 with 0 points and a 1-11 goal record (0-4 at Brighton, 1-4 at home to Brann, 0-3 at Lugano), and Riga FC, 19th-20th after three 1-1 draws. Riga play their first game under new coach Didier Zanetti, who replaced Adrian Gula on Sunday, and Lithuanian reports expect them to keep their usual attacking style. Both domestic seasons are over (Zalgiris champions, Riga second), and Zalgiris players have spoken of physical and mental tiredness, though coach Zeljko Sopicius reported no new injuries. Riga's long-term absentee Varslavans is already counted and referee Daniyar Sakhi (confirmed, 3.0 cards in one game) is in the numbers; match-day line-up news was thin again, so the view rests on earlier reports and form.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals and already trim Zalgiris for scoring 3 in their last six. Riga come in after three straight 1-1 draws and a coaching change days ago, and a tired Zalgiris side at the end of their season has scored once in three European games, so I trim a little to about 2.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners, 4.9 for Zalgiris at home, already trimmed for their few recent corners. Reports expect Riga to keep their attacking style under Zanetti rather than change shape, so I stay at 8.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards, already cutting Riga for only 2 cards in their last three and taking a little off for referee Daniyar Sakhi's low record. It is a Baltic meeting but not a real rivalry, so I stay at 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.9 shots, already lifting Riga (47 shots in their last three) and trimming Zalgiris. Zalgiris' fatigue and the long break could slow the game, but they need a first point at home and say they expect to be the stronger side, so I stay at 27.9.
